paragraphs.text: Plane is a card type representing locations throughout the Multiverse , used exclusively on oversized cards unique to the Planechase format. Every plane card has a subtype corresponding to the plane the location is found on.

Planes are twice the size of a regular Magic card with a special, horizontally oriented frame . Almost all structural parts of the card face are translucent for the artwork. On top of the card is the name box. At the bottom is a text box that is separated into two halves vertically. On top is the regular card ability. On the bottom is the Chaos ability, preceded by a large chaos symbol. The background of the Chaos ability is also a slightly darker shade than the regular ability. On top of the text box is a type-line box with the type-line centered and the expansion symbol on the right. The information below the text box is centered. The boxes are all bordered with ornamental copper lines that decorate the rest of the card as well.
The plane frame is shared with phenomenon cards.

Planar types are the only subtypes (other than the creature type " Time Lord ") where spaces are considered part of a single name, rather than separators between different subtypes. Therefore, no Plane cards have multiple subtypes. Only five planes have spaces in their names: The Abyss, Bolas's Meditation Realm, The Library, New Phyrexia, and Serra's Realm.
From the Comprehensive Rules (September 25, 2026— Reality Fracture )

205.3n Planes have their own unique set of subtypes; these subtypes are called planar types.
